purpose: Zero-shot transfer of planning-trained BFS adapters to FOLIO, HumanEval and GSM8K. This is a resource- and protocol-frozen comparison; no adapter is selected or rerun by transfer-test success.

base_model.note: identical pin to configs/experiments/matched-modalities/study-v5.json; all benchmarks are text-only, so every cell receives identical text prompts (matched-prompt contract)

official_source.version_note: FOLIO v0.0 validation split, the official public evaluation set (test labels are unreleased). The HF yale-nlp/FOLIO v2 update is access-gated and was unreachable without credentials; v0.0 is the official GitHub release, pinned by commit and file hash.

folio.subset_rule: 204 examples exceed the 200-example cap. Strata = gold label. Hamilton apportionment of 200 seats over strata (True 72 -> 70, Uncertain 69 -> 68, False 63 -> 62); within each stratum take the first k examples in original file order. Selection uses label strata and file order only, never model outcomes.

prompt.system: You are a careful logical reasoner.

parsing.rule: first case-insensitive whole-word regex match of True|False|Uncertain in the raw output; if none, the prediction is malformed and scored incorrect

folio.metric: accuracy over the frozen subset; malformed reported separately

gsm8k.subset_rule: 1319 test examples exceed the 200-example cap. Strata = quartiles of reasoning-step count over the full test set, where step count = number of calculator annotations '<<' in the gold answer (fallback: number of non-empty lines before '####'). Quartile boundaries computed on all 1319 examples; Hamilton apportionment of 200 seats across the four strata; within each stratum take the first k examples in original file order. Selection uses cost/strata only, never model outcomes.

prompt.system: You are a careful mathematical reasoner.
prompt.user_template:
Solve the following grade-school math word problem. Show your reasoning briefly, then give the final answer on a new line in the form '#### <number>'.

Problem: {question}

parsing.rule: official-style: take the text after the last '####' occurrence in the raw output and parse the first number (commas, $ and trailing punctuation stripped); fallback if no '####': the last number appearing anywhere in the output; compare with the gold final number by exact string equality after normalization, else float equality with tolerance 1e-6
parsing.gold_rule: gold answer = number after '####' in the official answer field
parsing.malformed_counts_as: no parseable number anywhere -> incorrect, reported separately

gsm8k.metric: accuracy over the frozen subset; malformed reported separately

humaneval.subset_rule: 164 problems is below the 200-example cap, so the complete official evaluation set is used (all task_ids HumanEval/0..163 in file order).

prompt.system: You are an expert Python programmer.
prompt.user_template:
Complete the following Python function. Respond with the complete function definition only, without explanations, examples, or tests.

```python
{prompt}```

extraction.rule: if the raw output contains a fenced code block, take the first ```python/``` block; else take the raw output. Strip leading/trailing blank lines. The extracted text must define the entry_point function; the scored program is the extracted text plus the official test field plus check(entry_point), exactly as in the official human-eval harness. Empty extraction or a program missing the entry point counts as failed and is reported malformed.

sandbox.executor: python -I subprocess per task, cwd = fresh temporary directory
sandbox.network: none: executed under 'unshare -n' when available, otherwise a sitecustomize shim that makes socket.socket raise; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES emptied; environment scrubbed to a minimal PATH/HOME
sandbox.imports: stdlib only as required by the official prompts/tests; no package installation at scoring time

humaneval.metric: pass@1 with a single greedy sample (exact pass rate over the frozen subset); execution errors and timeouts are failures and are reported by category

decoding.batching: left-padded batches via BatchedPolicyAdapter; per-benchmark max_new_tokens from the benchmarks block; max_batch_size 8; max_batch_input_tokens 48000; max_context_tokens 8192; generation stops at EOS regardless of allowance
decoding.cache: identical (adapter, canonical prompt) pairs memoized within one worker process only; no cross-run cache

resource_gate.cost_unit: generated tokens (frozen per-benchmark max_new_tokens allowance) plus, for humaneval, one sandboxed test execution per (problem, cell) with the frozen limits
resource_gate.probe_examples: per benchmark, the p50 and p95 input-token-length examples of the frozen L0 subset (6 probes total), plus the minimum-length example for the token-limit guard; probe outputs are retained but are never scored and evaluation re-runs every example fresh
measurements_required: model loading wall time per worker
scalar vs batched byte-identical parity for base and each adapter on the probe set
repeated-batch determinism: two uncached runs byte-identical
token-limit guard: input tokens + allowance <= max_context_tokens enforced
adapter isolation: disabling adapters restores byte-identical base outputs
lower-95% throughput (generated tokens/second) per benchmark on the probe set

admission_rule.L0: sum over benchmarks of p95_probe_seconds_per_example x subset_size x 4 cells, plus measured model-load time once per worker, times safety factor 1.25, fits within 24 GPU-hours per-GPU and within the absolute GPU cutoff 2026-09-21T11:55:19Z
admission_rule.L1: if L0 does not fit but the frozen reduced panel does: folio 100 / gsm8k 100 / humaneval 82, obtained by taking even-numbered positions of each frozen L0 ordered subset (halving every stratum proportionally); L1 is frozen here before outcomes and is never re-derived from results
admission_rule.L2: otherwise VALID_STOP: resource failure, no transfer evaluation runs

leakage_prevention.adapter_corpora: the three BFS adapters were trained only on 512 planning-search records per cell (seed 17) from outputs/modality_corpus/issue74-matched-32k-v1 (see each cell report.json training_record_ids); benchmark content is not planning data
leakage_prevention.check: normalized-token 8-gram containment between every frozen benchmark input (premises+conclusion / question / prompt) and the full text of the issue74-matched-32k-v1 corpus records; any shared 8-gram is reported per benchmark item
leakage_prevention.base_model_note: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct pretraining data is not auditable by this project; possible benchmark contamination of the base model is disclosed as a limitation, not measured here
leakage_prevention.test_use: frozen subsets, prompts and decoding are fixed before any evaluation output; no test-driven adapter selection, reruns, or prompt changes

execution_topology.note: one backbone per worker in fp32 with hot-swapped PEFT adapters; cell order fixed; approximately balanced by expected generated tokens (gsm8k ~200x4 long generations vs folio short + humaneval medium)
execution_topology.scheduler: scripts/run_expanded_study.py; per-stage logs, heartbeats, terminal status, completion hooks and duplicate-launch refusal per the #116 contract

retained: frozen raw benchmark files with sha256 and subset manifests
raw model outputs for every (benchmark, cell, example) including malformed ones
parsed predictions, scoring details and humaneval execution logs
probe measurements and the admission decision
evidence.publication: compact JSON + markdown narrative under docs/experiments/expanded-study/
evidence.valid_stop_contract: VALID_STOP for resource or ordinary threshold failure; INVALID for provenance, replay or execution mismatch; partial coverage is reported as missingness, never silently dropped
